objective: Preallocate HNSW wrapper vector storage when batch insertion creates a vector index wrapper.

tasks.title: Preallocate vector batch wrapper storage
tasks.result: VectorIndex batch insertion now creates a new HNSW wrapper with vector-map capacity derived from the batch size.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
Existing wrappers still use the existing reserve(items.len()) path before applying a batch.
The optimization only changes initial HashMap capacity for newly-created HNSW wrappers; vector dimension validation, rebuild, delete, and search semantics are unchanged.
